property_summary: For every admissible call, Command must forward exactly the attached msg.value to the target callee (so a recorder helper observes received == msg.value, regardless of any pre-existing balance in c); the mutant forwards address(this).balance instead, so with any pre-existing balance in c the recorded value exceeds msg.value.
change_summary: Changed the value forwarded from msg.value to address(this).balance so the call sends the contract's entire balance instead of the attached value.
